notes.title: Slap Report
notes.content:
Hello, strong Slappers.

You all probably know this already, but I had to take Butt Slapper work down a notch in favor of getting my other game's demo ready for Next Fest.

[h2]But I still have food for you[/h2]

This month's tiny update includes 6 new Butts:

[b]Rare Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Low Poly Golden Butt
[*] Office Light Butt
[*] Office Tan Butt
[*] Office Dark Butt
[/list]
[b]Exquisite Butt[/b]
[list]
[*] Hot Dog Butt
[/list]
[b]GYATT Butt[/b]
[list]
[*] Dildo Butt
[/list]
You can check the [url=https://amarillo-arts.net/Games/ButtSlapper/Gallery/ButtGallery.html]updated Drop Rates site here[/url]. If it doesn't want to update for you, try opening it in an incognito window.

[h2]Random Bunny Ada art[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/21f2e78c216d52a818b23a5fca7a4fa56790f08f.png[/img]

[h2]Here are a few other changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Reduced the drop window from 24 hours to 23. This will let you be able to open the game at the same time every day.
[*] Reduced the probability to get a Man Butt Crate from 10% to 5%. This means that you'll get a regular Butt Crate 95% of the time now.
[*] Fixed a bug that made Crow Girl Butt white instead of a dark shade of purple.
[*] Removed deprecated butts (Thong Butt and Butt Naked Butt) from the Butt-a-pedia. They will still show up if you do own them.
[/list]
If you're curious about my other game (or if you want to know what I sound like), you can check the free demo below. It focuses on the character creator, but I plan on letting you interact with all my original characters in the full release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3152580/Amarillos_Desktop_Pets_Demo/

Loves you,
Amarillo

- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation

notes.title: A new dimension of SLAP is upon us
notes.content:
What's a-poopin', slapparillos?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/374ebde49f433b7fc9e2d4e9827050d80feda496.jpg[/img]

Today I'm bringing two pieces of very requested content into the game.

[h1]Bobs out![/h1]

I'm proud to announce that after many weeks of human experimentation and genetic splicing, I have finally been able to produce the first viable specimen of the upper human section. Introducing, the only of its kind: [b]The Boob Butt[/b].

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/8f9ff55d8f0a3c866bf61f85a3b34599d897970c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/8f9ff55d8f0a3c866bf61f85a3b34599d897970c.gif[/img][/url]

[h1]Manly love[/h1]

You've slapped millions of round, soft and juicy butts, but those are games for little kids. There comes a time in the life of a man when he must look himself in the mirror. Face his own demons. Perhaps even admire his own butt at least once (we've all done it, don't lie). Slappers, I'm not gonna lie to you, this will be your toughest challenge yet. You will slap yourself.

Which is why I'm finally adding a bunch of man Butts! Here's how that will work. You will keep getting your regular Butt Crates most of the time -which contain [i]only[/i] female butts- but there's a smaller chance you'll get a new Man Butt Crate. These will be rarer, though not limited to any event. You'll always be getting a few of those. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/81131796effa66aee88aec2d3585b621e08c9cdc.png[/img]

If you do not dare look inside the Butt of You, you can always exchange the Man Butt Crates for some AMACoin, or just sell them on the market.

[h1]All the new Butts[/h1]

[h2]Butt Crate[/h2]

[b]Uncommon Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Yoga Pants Light Butt
[*] Yoga Pants Tan Butt
[*] Yoga Pants Dark Butt
[/list]
[b]Rare Butts[/b]
[list]

[*] Yoga Pants Thicc Butt
[*] Kunoichi Butt
[/list]
[b]Exquisite Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Ada Chicken Butt
[*] Boba Chicken Butt
[*] Clara Chicken Butt
[*] Estela Maid Butt
[/list]
[b]GYATT Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Boobs Nude Butt
[/list]
[h2]Man Butt Crate[/h2]

[b]Common Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Man Light Butt
[*] Man Tan Butt
[*] Man Dark Butt
[/list]
[b]Uncommon Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Dan Femboy Butt
[*] Cacked Up Streamer Butt
[/list]
[b]Rare Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Dan Femboy Hooplers Butt
[*] Gooner Butt
[/list]
[b]Exquisite Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Mankini Light Butt
[*] Mankini Tan Butt
[*] Mankini Dark Butt
[/list]
[h1]Other stuff[/h1]

I have added a new option in the Settings menu. Filters. These will let you completely hide Nude and Male Butts from the game. I might introduce other filters in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/85a0ccf1172c51beb7b43525b25358d2859a833e.png[/img]

The Holidays Butt Crate is officially out of circulation. No more Holidays for us!

The drop rates website is still not 100% up to date. It will probably take me one extra day working on it with the current rates and butts.

Lastly, I'll enable Steam Cloud again in around a week. The save system seems to be working as best as  I can squeeze it, so it might be time. Steam Cloud will only sync your slaps, upgrades and backgrounds. Your inventory is always saved to the Inventory Service. If you'd like to be extra safe, you can make a backup of your current save file. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3231090/discussions/1/4851030529138268266/]Here's where to find it[/url].

[h1]One more thing![/h1]

Some of you might have already seen this one in my socials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/1cc2d5dd093a553f545972b4a5ef8e49317cdbab.jpg[/img]

I like making jokes (even at my own expense) and parodies of some trends. While that's more or less the vibe with that announcement, it is also true that I have plans for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3425530/Amarillos_Vehicular_Manslaughter/]many more games in the near future[/url]. I've been thinking about what a hypothetical Amarillo's Butt Slapper 2 would be, and I came up with some ideas that I would have a lot of fun making. But that's still a ways off, so don't expect any news about it during this year. Just rest assured I'm not gonna be pulling an Overwatch 2 on you. This Butt Slapper will forever remain the little flawed but charming game that it is right now.

notes.title: HI
notes.content:
Hello baddies. Would you still love me if I was a little worm who took longer to update the game?

I've been working on my [url=https://www.instagram.com/p/DFDqN1wR49J/]future projects[/url] very hard. Desktop Pets is getting a free demo very soon, right on time for the coming Next Fest; and I've started preparing the ground for my 3rd Steam game: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3425530/Amarillos_Vehicular_Manslaughter/?curator_clanid=45091732]Amarillo's Vehicle Manslaughter[/url].

But I should still apologize for not updating Butt Slapper yet. I am a stinky, I admit it. I'm sorry.

[h3]Alright let's talk business now![/h3]

First, in around a [b]week[/b]'s time, I'll be [b]retiring the Holidays Butt Crate[/b]. That will be the end of the Holidays event.

Second, chicken enthusiasts, I know you're out there. This one's for you. I'm adding Chicken suit Butts for [b]Ada, Boba and Clara[/b]. Here's a little preview of the art I made for them just today.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/7fa56d27a4ac0a4b26de9db5a594cd98fe410aea.png[/img]

Third, man lovers rejoice: I'm [b]adding male Butts to the game[/b]. The next update will also add a few filters you can set in the Settings menu. This will protect your beautiful eyes from seeing some types of butts you don't like. The filters will be: NSFW and Male. If you check the NSFW filter, every time a Butt with nudity shows up, it will be completely black. Same thing with the male Butts.

Lastly, I want to introduce two new original characters whose Butts you'll be able to slap. They are [b]Estela and Dan[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/deb0ee204971faffe163ad9387034f06c5eb372f.png[/img]
[i]Estela. I first presented her a [url=https://x.com/amarilloarts_/status/1868381547767923050]while ago in my socials[/url].[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/2e054d105bf00b8bb42f3e9f7bae01b44b77aaf9.png[/img]
[i]Dan. I made him back when I was dipping my toes into the spicy animations territory. I didn't quite enjoy the process, so he ended up being forgotten until now. He'll be repurposed into a Femboy now, haha.[/i]

That's it for now! I've got a cool bunch of Butts ready, and some more in the way. Once again, I'm sorry for letting you all starve for so long. 

Loves you very much, [strike]your fa-[/strike] Amarillo

- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation

notes.title: Christmas Butt cache
notes.content:
Hello Slappers, it's me, the Butt-maniac.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/d601d1d921ab9c23d89a24a8d069a3374f5d17ab.jpg[/img]

I've got something to tell you, but first, here's what's new.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/f263d6b74481c8a16d9b357cf18d686d2a0291ca.gif[/img]

[h3]New Christmas Butts[/h3]
I'm adding 6 new Butts to the Holidays Butt Crate:

[b]Exquisite Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Ada Christmas Butt
[*] Boba Christmas Butt
[*] Clara Christmas Butt
[/list]
[b]GYATT Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Ada Christmas Nude Butt
[*] Boba Christmas Nude Butt
[*] Clara Christmas Nude Butt
[/list]
Drop rates [url=https://amarillo-arts.net/Games/ButtSlapper/Gallery/ButtGallery.html]website here[/url] for more details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/293ef28f4e057d92f698fee3a7d6c6f9aea7d789.png[/img]

[h3]New backgrounds in the Slap Shop[/h3]
These are premium animated backgrounds, costing 1 million slaps each. Even though they are Christmas themed, they won't be limited to the Holidays event. You'll be able to buy these even after the current event ends.
[list]
[*] Ada Christmas
[*] Boba Christmas
[*] Clara Christmas
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/3cb1828f503611ac963b1056ad7485bab8bf903e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/8f020bf6a2ed9b2566f59bb1667355511378361a.png[/img]

[h2]Now, here's something important I gotta tell you all[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/3ec8f41b0d67368c68b3d643fd723160984030ec.gif[/img]

Let me come forward and share my latest L with you all. TL;DR: there's no Butt Slapper team anymore. It's just me now, like the good old days (a month ago).

[h3]What happened?[/h3]

Nothing dramatic, just a mix of personal life decisions and money. Let's just say, I can't really afford a team :'V

[h3]What does this mean for Butt Slapper?[/h3]

I'm going to scale development down. I won't work on new features, unless they're [i]really[/i] necessary.

I'm also probably not going to fix the issues with the Butt Exchange system; because it's a very complex programing task that goes beyond my skills as a developer (in my defense, Valve's Inventory Service is REALLY complex to work with).

And I will very likely not do custom hand skins.

[h3]Will the game keep getting updates?[/h3]

[b]Yes[/b]. I will keep making content. That is, Butts, events, backgrounds and art.

[h3]What will you focus on then?[/h3]

While I'm going to reduce the time I spend developing Butt Slapper, I will start pouring more resources into my next projects. That is [i]mainly[/i] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094870/Amarillos_Desktop_Pets/]Desktop Pets[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/e2420d0ca2cce81eb3cd17dade60c92d5196171e.gif[/img]

Sorry about the bad news! Things sometimes don't work the way you plan them. But my love for this project and my commitment to the community isn't changing. As long as you keep enjoying this little game, I'll keep making new content.

- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation

notes.title: Butt Slapper maintenance patch
notes.content:
I salute you, slappers of butts. This new patch is a very small one, but comes with a few things to talk about.

[h3]Background scroll fixed in the in-game Inventory[/h3]
Small dumb bug, but we got it fixed now. Sorry about that!

[h3]Drop rates website updated[/h3]
The dedicated website has been finally updated with the new Butts and all their drop rates. Be sure to force it to update it by pressing Ctlr + F5. If you still can't see the new Butts, consider using incognito mode or changing browser. We'll work on this fixing inconvenience, which is a result of how the website caches its data.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/163b113101634e6e7246697cb13316574f0dd00c.jpg[/img]

You can find a link to it by going to the Butt Crates menu, or by clicking this [url=https://amarillo-arts.net/Games/ButtSlapper/Gallery/ButtGallery.html]Doobly-Doo[/url].

[h3]New Slap-Support email[/h3]
As part of the process of me slowly handing the development tasks to the Butt Slapper team, I have created a dedicated email account for providing support with technical issues. If you need direct communication with the team, send an email to:

[code]ButtSlapperSupport@amarillo-arts.net[/code]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/d4924ba80c42db71207cd76bc99b70083579bec8.png[/img]

Be sure to follow the instructions in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3231090/discussions/1/4851030529138268266/]this pinned Discussions post[/url].

Until the next time.
- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/3709bdcf768ab6c857843ee77327fa51c1c8ebe0.jpg[/img]

WE ARE SO BACK 🗣️🗣️

Hello peeps and poops. First of all, an apology for taking so long. I personally needed to slow the pace after a few crazy months of almost non-stop Butt development. Believe it or not, a man can get burned out of seeing butts all day.

Here's what we're bringing into the game:

[h3]A Buncha Butts[/h3]
The regular Butt Crate pool gets updated with new additions:

[b]Uncommon Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Half Assed Butt

[/list]
[b]Exquisite Butt[/b]

[/list]
[b]GYATT Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Milker Butt
[*] [url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/72zDORX7tPs]Nyanners Goro[/url]
[/list]
If you didn't know, [url=https://www.dexerto.com/twitch/vtuber-nyanners-banned-on-twitch-while-playing-butt-slapping-simulator-2958977/]Butt Slapper did get Nyatasha Nyanners banned from twitch[/url] a few weeks ago, so I decided to collab with her and add her ghostly cat pet into the game.

[h3]The new Seasonal Holidays Butt Crate (lasting until January 2025)[/h3]
This new limited Crate comes with all these Butts:

[b]Common Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Thanksgiving Dark Butt
[*] Thanksgiving Light Butt
[*] Thanksgiving Tan Butt
[/list]
[b]Uncommon Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Clowny Butt
[*] Raven Girl Butt
[/list]
[b]Rare Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Brazilian Virtual Singer Butt
[*] Useless Mage Butt
[*] Fighter of Streets Butt
[/list]
[b]Exquisite Butts[/b]
[list]
[*] Girlpool Butt
[*] Jane Sue Butt
[*] Ada Turkey Butt
[*] Boba Turkey Butt
[*] Clara Turkey Butt
[/list]
[b]GYATT Butt[/b]
[list]
[*] Thanksgiving Idol Butt
[/list]
I will be adding more Butts to this limited Holidays Butt Crate with Christmas and New Years Butts.

[h3]The Slap Shop[/h3]
I have created a new section for the Crate Lab menu called The Slap Shop. Here you'll be able to buy different animated backgrounds for the game using your Slaps. I will also be adding more interesting backgrounds in the future!

[h3]Butt Exchange[/h3]
Also in the Crate Lab, you'll find the Butt Exchange menu, where you can "sell" any Butt you want to get rid of, and get some AMACoin in return. This is great if you want to order some Holiday Butt Crates using that AMACoin!

[h3]Bye bye, Spooky Butt Crate[/h3]
After almost a month since Halloween, it's past time I phased this Crate out. Now, instead of getting Spooky Butt Crates, you'll be getting Holidays Butt Crates at the same rate. If you own a bunch of Spooky Butt Crates, they will still be good to open and trade. The only thing that has changed is that there isn't a way to generate new Spooky Butt Crates anymore. At least until the next Halloween event comes!

[h3]New save system[/h3]
We worked on [i]yet another new save system[/i]. As I, Amarillo, am not a [b]great[/b] programmer, the new Butt Slapper team worked on this. I sincerely hope this brings to an end the repeated issues people with unstable power sources have been having all this time.

[h3]New original soundtrack[/h3]
My buddy [url=https://www.instagram.com/mutante.robot/]Mutante Robot[/url] composed a few original tracks for the game. These are stream-friendly (even if the game isn't so too much), so fear no copyright claims. While Mutante made 99% of the music, I did personally step in to play the bass lines.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/509734556236860b9b5c4701e1db09e724fec69a.png[/img]

That's it for now! Little by little the development of Butt Slapper will be handed to the yet-to-be-named Game Studio of the friend I have partnered with. I will keep working on the Butts and art, but the code and maintenance will be in better hands.

I'm sorry to all the people that have been experiencing problems with the saves!

See you around. Don't forget that you can always join my [url=https://discord.com/invite/amarillo]Discord [/url]and reach out to me (or my mods) directly if there's anything you need help with.

- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/5ef2efe6dff1c55da44b8262e1c0e2872f8fe2dd.jpg[/img]

Hello Slappers. Very soon it's going to be time to push the update I've been cooking (along with the new Butt Slapper team) after what seems like a very long time. There is one very important change I want you to be aware of:

[b]I'll remove the option to buy Spooky Butt Crates using AMACoin![/b]

This is because the Halloween event will be officially ending at the time the new update comes. If you've been saving to buy many Spooky Butt Crates, now is the time! After the new update comes, there will not be any way to buy more Spooky Butt Crates.

[h3]When will the Holidays Update come?[/h3]
99% likely that it will be ready on Sunday 24th of November. That's very soon!

[h3]What will the Holidays Update include?[/h3]
[list]
[*] A bunch of new Butts
[*] A new limited Butt Crate for the Holidays event
[*] The Slap Shop: An in-game store where you can buy backgrounds using your Slaps
[*] Butt Exchange: Get rid of any Butts you don't want and get some AMACoin in return
[*] A slappy original soundtrack for the menus
[*] Yet another attempt to solve the loss of progress after your PC shutsdown suddenly due to a power outage
[/list]

[h3]How long will the Holidays event last?[/h3]
Until the next year. This event will include Butts for Thanksgiving, Christmas and the New Year.

I'll be adding more Butts both during and after the Holidays event. Another important pending feature is the ability to buy skins for the hands using AMACoin.

That's it for now. See you soon!

- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation

notes.title: Management change
notes.content:
Hello dear slapping community.

I have taken a very difficult but necessary decision. While I, Amarillo, will keep working on everything art-related (Butts and character graphics), I am handing over the development of this game to a more experienced partner who will ensure it gets up to a higher standard to meet all your needs and expectations.

It's not easy to admit, but I personally haven't been able to deliver a product with all the functionality and polish an audience as big as this requires. I am struggling to solve basic things like the loss of progress for a lot of people, and adding new features (AMACoin, Slap Shop) to the game -that I didn't originaly plan- is making the project grow to a level of complexity that now exceeds my capabilities.

While I do have experience making simple games, Butt Slapper stopped being that when it grew in popularity. I don't believe this project can be lead by a single person of my characteristics. I am better suited for making smaller and more personal creations. Butt Slapper has turned into a living and breathing game that needs constant attention and work put into it, as it evolves together with its community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/9e748cb2e5c908cab2647367d3128386669d15a1.jpg[/img]

[h3]Who are you partnering with?[/h3]
A friend I met back when I was a student. He has worked on some startups and has a lot of experience running projects. At this time he's in the process of forming his own studio. When he does, I'll add its name to the game and tell you about it.

[h3]Will there be changes to the game?[/h3]
The idea is that the only changes will be improvements. Here's our internal roadmap for the coming days:
[list]
[*] Create the Slap Shop, where you can buy backgrounds using your slaps.
[*] Phase out the Spooky Butt Crates and add a new seasonal Crate for the coming holidays.
[*] Fix the loss of progress bug after a power outage.
[*] Add even more Butts to the game (for the regular Butt Crate and the new seasonal crate coming up)
[*] Create a way to "buy" hand skins with AMACoin (so that you have a good reason to exchange your repeated Butts for AMACoin)
[/list]
[h3]When are you going to update the game?[/h3]
I'd rather be honest with you and tell you that I don't want to hurry with it. I'd prefer to do things the right way. If that means a loss of hype and less interest in the game, so be it. I owe you the best I can do, so I won't rush our work. At this very moment, my friend and I are working on putting him up to date with all the ins and outs of the game and planning the development and fixes.

But we do have a deadline for the next big update. At the very latest, we will have a big update one week before Thanksgiving, that is the 21st of November. Hopefully it won't take us that long.

[h3]What will happen with Desktop Pets?[/h3]
I know a lot of you are very interested in my next game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094870/Amarillos_Desktop_Pets/]Amarillo's Desktop Pets[/url]. This merger of sorts won't affect it. In fact, I have a lot of love for working as a solo dev. It makes my projects feel 100% mine and I always want to have that. One of the main reasons I'm partnering up for Butt Slapper is to have more time to work on Desktop Pets and all my other projects.

Much love from me, and apologies for all the bumps in the road.

notes.title: Community Market bots
notes.content:
Hey there, community of badasses.

I woke up today with the seemingly good news that the game had reached a new peak in player count of 110K. That was very exciting at first, but then I came to realize that it was most likely bots looking to make a quick profit by ruining the market for everybody else.

I have made both Butt Crates and Spooky Butt Crates temporarily untradable. I will hear your feedback on this if this does affect regular players negatively. Although you can still buy and sell them in the market, my hope is that this will make it harder for bots to move high volumes of Crates between accounts.

I'll be here monitoring things and listening to your feedback.

[h3]Edit:[/h3]

MY FELLOW SLAPPERS, WE GOT 'EM

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/d25f3d6fcd56ea953dda7ffcddad4f1614646bf6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/7d33c37faaed4f06fa54c78cffb3dd7e29d15da1.png[/img]

SteamDB was even cool enough to add a marker with the fix I just implemented. As you can see, we are back to our true numbers. 2000 real, true slappers.

YOU MAKE ME PROUD.

Let's now hope we can keep the bots at bay for a good while.

notes.title: ARISE, SLAPPERS
notes.content:
It is me, the sculptor of Butts coming with a big spooky update for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/f1c4e1fb5eec1dd90e10efd4818fd9d7c8776009.jpg[/img]

[h1]Crate Lab[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/086f5dbb09ddb073169a407ed75ac865ce9fbe93.jpg[/img]

In order to make the Butt Crates more valuable, I have created a new menu that will let you exchange them for a new type of limited seasonal Butt Crate: The Spooky Butt Crate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/ab7d99109c6a36d5ceb06da0587202d10e47292f.jpg[/img]

In there, you will find 12 new Halloween-themed Butts. In ascending order of rarity:

[list]
[*]Panties Spooky Butt
[*]ThighHighs Spooky Butt
[*]Creature 68 Butt
[*]Ghostly Butt
[*]Jack O Butt
[*]Zombie Butt
[*]Franken Butt
[*]Five Nights At Butt
[*]Ada Devil Butt
[*]Boba Ghost Butt
[*]Clara Mummy Butt
[*]Xeno Butt
[/list]
For the full drop rates, you can always visit the special [url=https://amarillo-arts.net/Games/ButtSlapper/Gallery/ButtGallery.html]website [/url]I created with the most up-to-date information. You might need to force a refresh with Ctrl + F5 to make sure you are seeing the latest version.

[h1]AMACoin[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/43bc203c9155fd1a8fdc9c026882c2d82c6922f8.gif[/img]

That's right, my butt destroying machines, you can now become fake-rich with my new fake-money. The whole purpose of this inventory currency is to let you get rid of your vast numbers of Butt Crates and have the ability to get something else in return. For now, you can only use AMACoin to obtain Spooky Butt Crates. In the future I may add other things to spend them on.

[h1]Special Butt Crates[/h1]

It took some elbow grease, but I finally expanded my Butt Crate system to allow for multiple types of Crates. Here is the first of more to come!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/91f3f3d1a8ad727a371f01d314f8e548518dd9ac.png[/img]

The Spooky Butt crate gives you a 75% chance to find a limited Halloween-themed Butt. Once you have a limited Butt in your inventory, it will be yours to keep forever. What makes them special is that they will only be generated during this seasonal event.

[h1]Quality of life fixes[/h1]

[h3]Better information on Crate drops[/h3]
I am adding a new widget with a bunch of useful information on the drops mechanics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/dabc282023487029d7f4b283c13bbcbaae221442.png[/img]

When opening the pause menu, you'll find it in the bottom-right corner of the screen. It shows a numeric timer for when the game will check for a Crate drop, along with the total number of crates you have received since you last opened the game. At present time, you should get 1 Butt Crate every 10 minutes while in the slapping part of the game (that is, not on the Main Menu).

This widget also shows a very important piece of information. Drop windows are not 100% clear to me in the way they work. I can define how many minutes long a drop window is, but I don't know for sure at what exact moment a drop window begins. A drop window is the length of time that it takes your daily drops to reset. Since you can get only 5 Butt Crates per day, that means that at some point that counter will reset back to 0. At which point exactly? My best guess is that the timer will start running once you receive your first Butt Crate in the current window. That is the assumption the widget uses to display the predicted time that the next drop window will begin.

It's complex!

[h3]Fixes for the save system[/h3]
A number of slappers have been reporting loss of game progress. This was a headscratcher to fix, but I think I might have finally found the culprit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/dda153bc94e12be839d0f906bbcf6e38f2403c0e.png[/img]

I will admit my fault here. I am very sorry for the frustrations my save system has caused to many of you. I am changing the way it works. Previously, I was trying to perform saves at many times. One of those was right before the game closed. This worked flawlessly for me and for the majority. Sadly, for some reason, on some systems this seems to have produced corrupted save files, as the game ended being closed right in the middle of the save writting process.

In order to fix that, I am now performing saves manually with less frequency, and never at random times. Your progress will be automatically saved when you return to the main menu, or when you purchase an upgrade. For this reason, you shouldn't close the game using the X button on the top right, or by using the task manager.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/f1ea032646ef69e1f0d2acac3abd0387abf3425e.png[/img]

It is definitely far from ideal, but I don't think there are many other things I can do. Saving automatically every X minutes can result in data loss if you happen to close the game right when a save happens. Games usually save your progress automatically at key moments, like when a level ends or when you defeat a boss. In our case, nothing like that happens, and the progress you make gets updated many times per second. Saving with such frequency could be dangerous.

[h3]Desktop Pet enjoyer achievement[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45204893/a30ea0ed4b2cec832fb175cfb89512254b724584.jpg[/img]

Since none of my plans involved having thousands of slappers active in the game, my initial offer of 20 free Butt Crates seemed like a great idea. Well, that backfired big time, because thanks to the high number of bots my Crates rapidly flooded the market. For that reason, I have disabled the 20 Butt Crates gift. Nonetheless, the achievement should still be possible to get, so I have added it back to the game. In order to obtain it, go to the credits menu. You'll find a big beautiful button in the last slide. Pressing that will make the magic happen.

[h3]Community Market[/h3]
As most of you know, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3231090/view/4526772422644888326]Valve themselves made the game's economy private[/url], hidding all the market listings and items from your inventories. This was due to the market icons for this game being determined to be inappropriate. I have since corrected all the icons. Your inventories should have been reestablished back to how they were before, with no loss of items.

[i]Edit: It seems that the icons aren't updating consistently after all. I'm looking into it right now. I updated all of the yesterday so I imagined they would have refreshed today, but that's not the case.

Edit 2: Icons are still not updating. In case the worst happens, and the economy gets made private again, just know that you won't lose your inventory items. You just won't be able to play the game until the economy is public.

Edit 3: I managed to update all the inventory icons manually. It's done! We're are safe, slappers.[/i]

That's it! I'll be monitoring things closely now. Leave your bug reports in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3231090/discussions/1/]official forum[/url] and I will do my best to solve any possible issue that pops up.

- The Amarillo Spicy Corporation
